# Hexlet Codebattle

> > A competitive programming game platform where developers battle head-to-head solving coding challenges in real-time tournaments.

Hexlet Codebattle is a multiplayer coding platform built with Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, React, and Redux. It features tournament systems including Swiss format and Grand Slam competitions, with Elo-based rankings and seasonal leaderboards for competitive programmers.

## Key Topics

- Hexlet Codebattle
- Competitive programming
- Head-to-head coding battles
- Tournament systems (Swiss format, Grand Slam)
- Elo rating system
- Seasonal leaderboards
- Multiplayer coding challenges
- Elixir and Phoenix LiveView
- React and Redux
- Real-time programming competitions
- Coding games
- Developer skill assessment
- Programming challenges

## Main Platform

- [Hexlet Codebattle • Game for programmers](https://codebattle.hexlet.io): Homepage for Hexlet Codebattle competitive programming game platform
